Name: Bigger Greenhouse1
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
This mod has been tested with 1.6.15, respectively SMAPI 4.2.1.0 / Content Patcher 2.6.1 on Windows 10/11.

This is a mod for the Greenhouse which should work with any farm layout (if you have problems, PLEASE comment so I can try to fix them).
It adds three exits (see image for further info); one for the Farmhouse, the Farm Cave, the Island House and the regular exit.

Edit: added a poster to the door leading to the Island Farm. :)



There is a possibility that your game could crash when you interact with the greenhouse before unlocking it.

Use at your own risk! Make sure to backup your save BEFORE using this. I do not take responsibility if your game crashes or you lose a savegame!

Downloads.Description:
Bigger Greenhouse with four exits (Farmhouse, FarmCave, regular exit to farm and Island House).
Now has a poster on the door that leads to the Farm Island.
